summary: The generic Governance CLI main wires LoadSnapshot, runHost and WriteOutput into Cli.run, with read-only watch/TUI paths handled separately. In that legacy host interpreter, DispatchReview consumes a fresh-review budget slot but returns an explicit error that fresh agent dispatch is not configured for the CLI run; it records the request as pending. Loading/saving cached reviews and pure review routing are real implementations, but they do not imply live agent dispatch. Scope this limit to this actual legacy CLI path, not every command/provider adapter or the whole repository. A CLI banner, parsed command, budget counter or cached verdict is not native review/effect acceptance.
title: Legacy CLI reports unconfigured fresh review rather than running an agent
